newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise/Suez seen having 4-member exec board.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise/Suez seen having 4-member exec board.

text.p: The executive board of the merged Lyonnaise des Eaux and Suez will comprise four members, two from each company, and be led by current Suez chairman Gerard Mestrallet, sources close to the negotiations said on Wednesday.
The other member from the Suez side will be Francois Jaclot while the Lyonnaise camp will supply current deputy chairman Guy de Panafieu and managing director Philippe Brongniart, the sources said.
Lyonnaise and Suez, who have announced a news conference for 1630 GMT on Friday to reveal their precise merger plans after the two boards meet that day, declined to comment on the information.
The merged group will have a supervisory board headed by current Lyonnaise chairman Jerome Monod.
